1d718ui:181: Three major pain points of traditional chaos engineering: high upfront cost of scenario design (manual design of fixed scenarios / real failures with multi-scenario stacking that cannot be exhaustively enumerated / product lines working in silos), mid-stage execution and diagnosis dependent on manual effort (untimely data collection / diagnosis based on experience / difficult recovery coordination), and post-stage analysis missing with results hard to reuse (no complete injection analysis / hard to form standardized playbooks / hacks cannot be accumulated). Deep-level consequence: resilience verification can only be a periodic targeted drill, unable to become high-frequency and routine—the real risk surfaces as production incidents during the gap between two drills.
